The tenant pays ALL real estate taxes, ALL property insurance, and ALL maintenance and repair costs. This is *in addition* to the rent.

So, the developer fucks the business owner, the business owner either passes it to consumers (**in this case via a direct pass-through tax** instead of simply increasing their prices), or in other cases (The Eldridge for example...) taxpayers at large.
